name: Simplex Minimum Energy Disguise
description: Replaced the orthogonal signature vectors with vectors forming a regular simplex. This changes the dot products from (4 for same, 0 for different) to (12 for same, -4 for different). The zero-sum target is replaced with a global minimum energy target of -4m. This removes the obvious '0' orthogonality affordance and introduces negative scores, which prevents models from instantly recognizing the equality check without doing algebraic deduction.
